items.stem: An AI assistant suggests a worksheet function you have never seen and it returns an error. What is the responsible next step?

options.text: Verify the function exists and is valid for your Excel version before using it
options.rationale: Correct: assistants can suggest non-existent or version-specific functions, so verification is essential.

options.text: Assume it is correct because the AI suggested it
options.rationale: AI output can be wrong or hallucinated and must be checked.

options.text: Report the error and switch off all formulas
options.rationale: Disabling formulas does not address the suggestion.

options.text: Paste it into every cell to see if it works somewhere

items.explanation: Correct: assistants can suggest non-existent or version-specific functions, so verification is essential.

items.stem: Which TWO habits keep AI-assisted spreadsheet work trustworthy? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Independently check a key AI-produced total against the source data
options.rationale: Correct: an independent check catches wrong ranges and hallucinated results.

options.text: Avoid putting sensitive personal data into prompts unless permitted and protected
options.rationale: Correct: data privacy and permissions must be respected.

options.text: Accept AI summaries verbatim to save time
options.rationale: Unverified summaries can carry errors into a decision.

options.text: Assume the assistant can read files you cannot access
options.rationale: Assistants operate within your existing permissions.

items.explanation: Correct: an independent check catches wrong ranges and hallucinated results.

items.stem: The assistant writes a confident paragraph of insights that the underlying data does not actually support. What should you do?

options.text: Rewrite the summary so every claim traces to a verifiable figure
options.rationale: Correct: narrative must match the data; unsupported claims should be removed or corrected.

options.text: Keep it because it reads well
options.rationale: Readability does not make an unsupported claim true.

options.text: Add more adjectives to strengthen it
Hide the data so no one can check

items.explanation: Correct: narrative must match the data; unsupported claims should be removed or corrected.
